description: The enclosed house's east wall, clapboarded, between the glazed/screened south porch at the sheet's left and the open (lattice-ended) north porch at the sheet's right, the gabled bay in the middle included (its face projects 2'-0"), from grade to the soffit; one window left of the bay, a paired window in the bay face, a small nine-light window and one window right of it.

length.note: plan's bottom string 18'-3" + 2'-0" + 16'-0 1/4" + 2'-0" + 18'-0 1/4" = 56'-3 1/2" (the same as the top string's printed overall for the west side). On the elevation the bay face's corner boards are at x 6419 and 8020 px (16.01 ft); the sheet-right corner, where the lattice porch begins, is at x 10020 px (20.00 ft from the bay, printed 20'-0 1/4"); the sheet-left corner is hidden behind the glazed porch's end frame (siding starts at x 4492 px, 19.27 ft from the bay where the plan prints 20'-3", which puts the corner at x 4394 px, used as left_x). Scaled 4492 to 10020 px is 55.28 ft.

eave.note: printed SOFFIT 8'-6 1/4" above FLOOR 0'-0" with GRADE -1'-3 1/2" on this elevation = 9.8125 ft (the house truth's heights.eave, 9.875 ft, uses the north/west grade -1'-4 1/4"). As on the west elevation the level marks and the drawing disagree vertically; the drawn grade line is at y 7618 px at the sheet-left corner and 7600 at the right (mean 7609). The drawn soffit (the fascia's lower edge where the wall starts) is at y 6575 px, 10.34 ft above the drawn grade; sill_ft is measured from the printed grade placed 9.8125 ft below it (y 7556 px).

openings.note: mean of the passes. A: plan rough opening 2'-8" | B: double-hung, south part of the wall; top at the head cap's top line, bottom at the sill's bottom line (the sill horns run about 5 px past the casings, not counted). Plan prints a 2'-8" window 6'-9 1/2" from the corner.

mean of the passes. A: a pair of double-hung windows in one trim with a wide centre casing (x 7176 to 7269 px), in the gabled bay's face (projecting 2'-0"): one opening | B: a pair of double-hung windows in one trim (shared centre casing) on the gable bay's face; the bay face is 2'-0" in front of the main wall
mean of the passes. A: small nine-light window (3 x 3 panes), plain frame trim | B: small nine-light window just north of the bay; plan prints it 2'-6" wide
mean of the passes. A: plan rough opening 2'-8" | B: double-hung, north part of the wall; plan prints it 2'-8" wide

porch: Nothing stands in front of the wall itself: the glazed/screened south porch is beyond the sheet-left corner (its end frame hides the last 1 ft or so of the wall) and the open north porch beyond the sheet-right corner.
